# Municipal Ordinance No. 11, Series of 2003

**Ordinance Regulating Tricycle and Jeepney Terminal Fees**

## Summary

This ordinance regulates the location of waiting areas for passenger tricycles at jeepney and bus terminals in Pitogo, Quezon. It also requires associations of tricycles and jeepneys to pay terminal fees. The ordinance designates specific streets as tricycle waiting areas and sets fees for each association.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Designates the side of Jose Abad Santos St. at A. Mabini St. as the waiting area for tricycles of Pototanin.
2.  **Section 2.** Designates the side of Jose Rizal St. at M.L. Quezon St. at Jose Pocol as the waiting area for tricycles.
3.  **Section 3.** Designates the side of Fabrica St. at E. Glinoga St. at A. Mabini St. in Brgy. Dulong Bayan as the waiting area for tricycles.
4.  **Section 4.** Designates the side of San Pablo St. at Jose Abad Santos at M.L. Quezon as the waiting area for Pitogo Jeepney Operator & Driver's (PJODA).
5.  **Section 5.** Requires each tricycle association to pay Two Hundred Pesos (₱200.00) per month as terminal fee.
6.  **Section 6.** Requires the Jeepney Operator and Driver of Pitogo (PJODA) to pay Six Hundred Fifty Pesos (₱650.00) per month as terminal fee.
7.  **Section 7.** Mandates the Municipal Treasurer's Office to collect the terminal fees from tricycle and jeepney associations.
8.  **Section 8.** Repeals any ordinance inconsistent with this ordinance.
9.  **Section 9.** Declares the invalidity of any provision shall not affect the other provisions.
10. **Section 10.** States that the ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its publication.
